childMarriagePercent null -> 1: no UNICEF/WB prevalence estimate exists for Australia (WB SP.M18.2024.FE.ZS empty; Girls Not Brides notes Australia publishes no prevalence rate). ABS registered marriages of minors are rare — a few hundred per year, almost all 16-17 with court authorisation, and the 16-19 female marriage rate halved after forced marriage was criminalised in 2013 — implying prevalence well under 1%. Set to 1 as a small real estimate per brief rule for rich countries.

Set to 1 as a small real estimate per brief rule for rich countries, consistent with AU/GB treatment.
